prompts.title: Audit and plan a project end to end
prompts.text: Use the audit-to-execution skill from https://github.com/tbachir/bag/tree/main/skills/audit-to-execution. Read BAG's root AGENTS.md and the skill, and my project's instructions. Audit the current state, research alternatives, create a verifiable cahier des charges, ROADMAP.md and TODO.md with stable IDs, recommended skills per task, implementation plan and reviewable PR when authorized. Do not merge or deploy.

prompts.title: Reconcile existing roadmap and work status
prompts.text: Use audit-to-execution from https://github.com/tbachir/bag/tree/main/skills/audit-to-execution after reading BAG root AGENTS.md and the target project's instructions. Reconcile STATUS.md, current CI/PR, TODO.md, ROADMAP.md and ADRs against actual evidence. Preserve completed work and stable IDs; do not check unverified tasks.

prompts.title: Discover skills for every task
prompts.text: Use audit-to-execution from https://github.com/tbachir/bag/tree/main/skills/audit-to-execution after reading BAG root AGENTS.md. Search the open skills ecosystem via find-skills and primary docs, not only BAG. For each actionable TODO task, recommend up to two reviewed skills and a discovery query, distinguishing installed vs suggested. Do not install unreviewed scripts.

prompts.title: Execute all feasible tasks without per-task interruptions
prompts.text: Use audit-to-execution run-all from https://github.com/tbachir/bag/tree/main/skills/audit-to-execution. Read BAG root AGENTS.md and the target repo instructions, then implement all safely feasible tasks in one continuous engagement, preserving dependencies and approvals. Defer noncritical missing environment or hardware checks until the end, continue unrelated work, run real tests and summarize remaining blockers with proofs. No unapproved merge/deploy.

prompts.title: Resume a partial multi-agent implementation
prompts.text: Use audit-to-execution resume + converge from https://github.com/tbachir/bag/tree/main/skills/audit-to-execution. Recheck Git, reviews, TODO, STATUS and EXECUTION-STATE, continue ready waves with minimal task contexts, avoid unsafe overlap and validate current deliverables. Finish with verified evidence and a deferred-only tail.

prompts.title: Run a bounded four-task pilot with cheap-first checks
prompts.text: Use audit-to-execution run-all --pilot on exactly 4 selected TODO IDs of this repository. Read its AGENTS and current status, verify open prerequisites, persist scoped checkpoint only when authorized, implement and test selected tasks, run fast preflight before expensive CI, stop at pilot cap, leave unrelated TODO untouched, and do not merge/deploy without separate approval. Report actual evidence and deferred environment checks; never invent speed/token savings.
